user_problem: Analysts inherit tables whose field meanings and constraints are scattered across notes.
unique_output: A field dictionary with source wording, normalized definition, type expectation, allowed values, null meaning, and open question.
test_case: Given six fields and imperfect notes, preserve known definitions and label two ambiguous null semantics as questions.
overlap_to_check: Spreadsheet skills, data catalogs, and record-contract audits.
specific_guardrail: Separate supplied definitions from sample-derived observations; unknown business meaning stays unknown. dataset-field-profiler owns observed type counts.
